title: Vanishing of shriek sections near a disjoint closed subset
statement: Let $j:U\to X$ be a weakly etale morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-weakly-etale-morphism] and let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $U\times_X Z=\varnothing$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $V\to X$ be an affine object of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-small-proetale-site] such that every point of $V$ specializes to a point of $V_Z=V\times_X Z$. For every abelian sheaf $G$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] on $U_{\mathrm{proet}}$, $(j_!G)(V)=0$, where $j_!G$ is the abelian sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the presheaf $W\mapsto\bigoplus_{\varphi:W\to U\text{ over }X}G(W\xrightarrow{\varphi}U)$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf, lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization].
